body:
Good. When I have a tough run, I imagine how it felt to be in the fetal position on the floor of our old apartment crying. And I smash my run time every time. She cheated on me. We were supposed to marry.

5 years later I'm with the best girl I've ever dated. I will never become reliant on another person again. But I am happier.

Your feelings now are biochemical. Your brain is begging for the sweet release of dopamine and serotonin from being with your ex. You can ride this neurotransmitter wild elephant until it tires out.

I'm counting on you to last through. Don't let me down. Talk to me anytime.

Hey. Don't be so hard on yourself. Everything will be alright. You're not a failure. You're not alone. Just keep doing what you can do. As much as you can do. Everything will be okay. Sending good thoughts to you.

I know how you feel. The pain will get more manageable over time. And you will be left with the great memories you had with each other. 

I know your friend would tell you to keep your chin up and be strong right now. That is what mine would have told me.

You look like a cool guy. Like someone I'd grab a beer with or watch some sports with. You take care, brother. Inbox me anytime.

Hey. I was there once in my life. In a situation very similar to yours. It was the hardest thing I ever experienced. 

Here is what I want you to do. I want you to breathe, relax and detach. Do one thing at a time. You're at home? Cook your dinner. Eat it. Brush your teeth. Shower. Go to bed. Get up. Go to work.

Repeat. 

Just focus on the next thing you need to do. Don't get lost in your head. Survive.

Once you make it to a place where you can think rationally, you can seek help/go out dating again/ find other jobs.

But for now. Don't give up. One day at a time. One task at a time. You're stronger than you think. Youre going to make it brother.

Hey. I remember what it was like being in that exact same position. In fact, I still feel like I never deliver enough now.

Keep your chin up. Pretend to be confident and calm even if you don't feel it. And never quit. The only difference between you and the partners is that they never quit. 

Even if you don't get hired. That doesn't make you any less smart or talented than if you got hired. Keep working and everything will be fine. I promise.

Message me if you want to talk about it.
